title: A connected juice press with fresh packs
text: A Wi-Fi connected countertop juice press that squeezes single-serve packs of chopped fresh fruit and vegetables, delivered weekly by subscription, so busy people get cold-pressed juice at home without cleaning a juicer.
outcome: Juicero shut down in September 2017, months after reporters showed the packs could be squeezed by hand as fast as the $400 machine.

key.riskiestAssumption: People will pay for an expensive press plus a subscription when the packs, a regular juicer or a bottle of cold-pressed juice give the same result for less.
key.notes: The deeper failure was that the machine added nothing over squeezing the pack by hand.
